title: Classical and quantum spectral density estimation under local graph access
summary: We study spectral density estimation for the normalized adjacency matrix of an unweighted graph under local access model. Previously, Cohen-Steiner et al. [KDD 2018] proposed an algorithm for $\varepsilon$-approximate spectral density estimation in the Wasserstein-1 distance, using $2^{O(1/\varepsilon)}$ local queries to the graph. In this paper, we prove that every constant-success estimator with Wasserstein--$1$ error at most $\eps$ requires $2^{Ω(1/\eps)}$ queries, showing that the Cohen-Steiner algorithm is optimal up to constant in the exponent.
